G0600:
ἀπο-καθ-ίστημι (ἀποκαθιστάω, Mrk.9:12, Rec., -ιστάνω, LTTr.; cf. Act.1:6; -κατιστάνω, WH), 
 [in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;] 
__1. to restore, i.e. to a former condition: of health, Mat.12:13, Mrk.3:5 8:25, Luk.6:10; of social or political affairs, Mat.17:11, Mrk.9:12, Act.1:6. 
 __2. to give back, bring back: Heb.13:19 (so in π., MM, see word; cf. also Cremer, 312).†
 (AS)
G0601:
ἀπο-καλύπτω 
 [in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה ] 
__1. in general sense (cl.), to reveal, uncover, disclose, 
 __(a) of things: Mat.10:26, Luk.2:35 12:2, 1Co.3:13; 
 __(b) of persons: pass., Christ, Luk.17:30; Antichrist, 2Th.2:3 2:6 2:8 
 __2. In LXX and NT, in special sense of divine revelation: Mat.11:25 (on the tense, see M, Pr., 136), ib. Mat.11:27 16:17, Luk.10:21-22, Jhn.12:38, Rom.1:17-18 8:18, 1Co.2:10 14:30, Gal.1:16 3:23, Eph.3:5, Php.3:15, 1Pe.1:5-12 5:1 (Westc., Eph., 178 f.; M, Th., 149 f.).†
 SYN.: φανερόω (see Thayer, 62; Cremer, 342).† (AS)
G0602:
ἀπο-κάλυψις, -εως, ἡ
 (ἀποκαλύπτω), [in LXX: 1Ki.20:30 (עֶרְוָה), Sir.11:27 22:22 42:1 * ;] 
an uncovering, laying bare (Plut.). Metaphorical, a reveal­ing, revelation: a disclosure of divine truth, or a manifestion from God: Luk.2:32 Rom.2:5 8:19 16:25, 1Co.1:7 14:6 14:26, 2Co.12:1 12:7, Gal.1:12 2:2, Eph.1:17 3:3 2Th.1:7 1Pe.1:7 1:13 4:13, Rev.1:1.†
 SYN.: ἐπιφάνεια, παρουσία, φανέρωσις (see Tr., Syn., xciv; Lft., Notes, 102, 178; Westc, Eph., 178 f.; M, Th., 145 ff.; Cremer, 343)  (AS)
G0603:
ἀπο-καραδοκία, -ας, ἡ
 (ἀποκαραδοκέω, used by Aq. in Psa.37:7 for חוּל; ἀπό, κάρα the head, δοκέω, in Ion., to watch), 
to watch with outstretched head, watch anxiously (Polyb., π.; see Deiss., LAE, 374.5, 377 f.), Rom.8:19, Php.1:20 (Lft., in l; Cremer, 177).†
 (AS)
G0604:
ἀπο-κατ-αλλάσσω
 (cf. καταλλάσσω: ἀπό here signifies completely, see Lft., Col., l.with; Ellic., Eph., l.with; but also Mey., Eph., l.with), 
to reconcile completely: Eph.2:16, Col.1:20-21.†
 (AS)
G0605:
ἀπο-κατά-στασις, -εως, ἡ
 (ἀποκαθίστημι), 
restoration: Act.3:21 (in τ. of repairs and restorations of temples, see MM, see word).†
 (AS)
G0606:
ἀπό-κειμαι 
 [in LXX: Gen.49:10 (שִׁילֹה), Job.38:23 (חָשַׂךְ), 2Ma.12:45, 4Ma.8:11 * ;] 
to be laid up, in store, laid away: Luk.19:20. Metaphorical, C. dative of person(s), to be reserved (Dem., Plat.; and see MM, see word): Col.1:5, 2Ti.4:8, Heb.9:27.†
 (AS)
G0607:
ἀπο-κεφαλίζω
 (ἀπό, κεφαλή), [in LXX: Psa.151:7 * ;] 
to behead: Mat.14:10, Mrk.6:16, 28 Luk.9:9.†
 (AS)
G0608:
ἀπο-κλείω 
 [in LXX chiefly for סָגַר ;] 
to shut fast: Luk.13:25.†
 (AS)
G0609:
ἀπο-κόπτω 
 [in LXX for קָצַץ, כָּרַת, etc. ;] 
to cut off: Mrk.9:43, 45, Jhn.18:10, 26 Act.27:32. Mid., to mutilate oneself, have oneself mutilated: Gal.5:12 (cf. Deu.23:1 LXX; and see Cremer, 751; MM, see word).†
 (AS)
G0610:
ἀπό-κριμα, -τος, τό
 (ἀποκρίνω); 
__1. prop., a judicial sentence: 2Co.1:9, R, mg. 
 __2. an answer (see Thayer, see word): 2Co.1:9, R, txt. (In FlJ, Ant., xiv, 10, 6, of a rescript of the Senate; in Inscr. of an official decision, Deiss., BS, 257; a reply to a deputation, MM, see word: cf. also Cremer, 3'75).†
 (AS)
G0611:
ἀποκρίνω, ἀποκρίνομαι, 
 [in LXX chiefly for ענה ;] 
in cl., 
__1. to separate, distinguish. 
 __2. to choose. 
Mid., to answer: Mat.27:12, Mrk.14:61, Luk.3:16 23:9, Jhn.5:17, 19 Act.3:12. In late Gk. the pass, also is used in this sense, and pass. forms are the more frequently in NT (M, Pr., 39, 161; MM, see word); 
__(a) in general sense: absol., Mrk.12:34; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.22:46; with dative of person(s), Mat.12:38; before πρός, Act.25:16; 
 __(b) Hebraistically 
__(i) like ענה, to begin to speak, take up the conversation (Kennedy, Sources, 124f.): Mat.11:25, al., 
 __(ii) redundant, as in the Heb. phrase וַיַּעַן וַיּאֹמֶר (Dalman, Words, 24f., 38; M, Pr., 14; Bl., §58, 4; 74, 2; Cremer, 374): ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπε, Mat.4:4; ἔφη, 8:8; λέγει, Mrk.3:33; in Jo most frequently (ἀπεκ. κ. εἶπε, 1:49. )
 (AS)
G0612:
ἀπό-κρισις, -εως, ἡ
 (ἀποκρίνομαι), [in LXX for דָּבָר, etc. ;] 
an answering, an answer: Luk.2:47 20:26, Jhn.1:22 19:9.†
 (AS)
G0613:
ἀπο-κρύπτω 
 [in LXX chiefly for סָתַר ;] 
to hide, conceal, keep secret: with accusative, Luk.10:21; pass., 1Co.2:7, Eph.3:9, Col.1:26 (MM, see word).†
 (AS)
G0614:
ἀπόκρυφος, -ον
 (ἀποκρύπτω), [in LXX Chiefly for סֵתֶר ;] 
hidden: Mrk.4:22, Luk.8:17, Col.2:3 (see Lft., in l; MM, see word).†
 (AS)
G0615:
ἀπο-κτείνω
 (also in late forms -κτέννω, Mat.10:28, a1., LTTr., -κτεννύω, Mrk.12:5, WH), [in LXX for הָרַג, מוּת ;] 
to kill: Mat.14:5, al.; before instr. ἐν (which see), Eph.2:16, Rev.2:23, al. Metaphorical: Rom.7:11; τ. ἔχθραν, Eph.2:16; τὸ γράμμα ἀποκτείνει 2Co.3:6 (on the perfective force of this verb, see M, Pr., 114) 
 (AS)
G0616:
ἀπο-κυέω
 (Rec. -κύω), -ῶ (ἀπό, κυέω or κύω, to be pregnant), [in LXX: 4Ma.15:17 * ;] 
prop., "the medical word for birth as the close of pregnancy" (Hort, Ja., 26 f.). In κοιν, "an ordinary syn. of τίκτω, but definitely 'perfectivised' (M, Pr., 111 ff.; MM, see word) by the
  ἀπό, and so implying safe delivery," to bring forth, give birth to: Jas.1:15, 18.†
 (AS)
G0617:
ἀπο-κυλίω
 (see: κυλίω), [in LXX: Gen.29:3, 8 29:10 (גָּלַל) Jdth.13:9 * ;] 
to roll away: Mat.28:2, Mrk.16:3, Luk.24:2.†
 (AS)
G0618:
ἀπο-λαμβάνω 
 [in LXX: Num.34:14 (לָקַח (Deu.25:5 A, Isa.5:17, 2Ma.4:46 2Mac 6:21 2Mac 8:6, 4Ma.18:23 * ;] 
__1. to receive from another; absol., to receive as one's due: Luk.16:25 18:30 (seel. λάβῃ) Luk.23:41, Rom.1:27, Gal.4:5, Col.3:24, 2Jn.8. 
 __2. to receive back: Luk.6:34 15:27. 
 __3. to take apart or aside: Mrk.7:33 (cf. use in π. of the recluses of the Serapeum; MM, see word).†
 (AS)
G0619:
ἀπόλαυσις, -εως, ἡ
 (ἀπολαύω, to take of, enjoy a thing) [in LXX: 3Ma.7:16 * ;] 
enjoyment: 1Ti.6:17, Heb.11:26 (for late exx., see MM, see word).†
 (AS)
G0620:
ἀπο-λείπω 
 [in LXX for H2308 יָתַר, etc. ;] 
__1. to leave, leave behind (in π. a term. techn. in wills; see MM, see word): 2Ti.4:13 4:20, Tit.1:5; pass., to be reserved, remain: Heb.4:6, 9 10:26. 
 __2. to desert, abandon: Ju 6.†
 (AS)
G0621:
ἀπο-λείχω
 (for ἐπιλ-, which see), 
to lick up: Luk.16:21, Rec.†
 (AS)
G0623:
Ἀπολλύων, -οντος, ὁ
 (present ptcp. of ἀπολλύω), 
Apollyon, i.e. the Destroyer: Rev.9:11 (cf. Ἀβάδδων). (Cremer, 453; DB, i, 125, 172.) †
 (AS)
G0624:
Ἀπολλωνία, -ας, ἡ 
 Apollonia, a city of Macedonia: Act.17:1.†
 (AS)
G0625:
Ἀπολλώς, -ώ, ὁ
 (perh. contr. from Ἀπολλώνιος, Act.18:24 D) 
Apollos: Act.18:24 19:1, 1Co.1:12 3:4-6 3:22 4:6 16:12, Tit.3:13.†
 (AS)
G0626:
ἀπολογέομαι, -οῦμαι
 (ἀπό, λόγος), [in LXX: Jer.12:1 (רִיב) Jer.31:6, 2Ma.13:26 * ;] 
__1. to defend: with accusative, Rom.2:15. 
 __2. to defend one's self: absol., Luk.21:14, Act.26:1; before ὅτι, Act.25:8; τί, to adduce something in one's defence, Luk.12:11, Act.26:24 (ταῦτα) Act.24:10 (τὰ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ); περί, with genitive of thing(s), and ἐπί, with genitive of person(s), Act.26:2; with dative of person(s), Act.19:33, 2Co.12:19.†
 (AS)
G0627:
ἀπολογία, -ας, ἡ
 (ἀπολογέομαι), [in LXX: Wis.6:10 * ;] 
a speech in defence: Act.25:16, 2Co.7:11, Php.1:7, 16, 2Ti.4:16; with dative of person(s), 1Co.9:3, 1Pe.3:15; before πρός, Act.22:1.†
 (AS)
G0628:
ἀπο-λούω 
 [in LXX: Job.9:30 (רָחַץ)* ;] 
to wash off, wash away; mid., metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), to wash off oneself: ἀμαρτίας, Act.22:16; absol., ἀπελούσασθε, ye washed yourselves clean (cf. Cremer, 406), 1Co.6:11.†
 (AS)
G0629:
ἀπο-λύτρωσις, -εως, ἡ
 (ἀπολυτρόω, to release on payment of  ransom, cf. λύτρον), [in LXX: Da (LXX) Dan.4:30 with * ;] 
release effected by pay­ment of ransom, redemption, deliverance; metaphorically, Heb.11:35; of deliverance thr. Christ from evil and the consequences of sin: Luk.21:28, Rom.3:24 (Vau., in l) 8:23, 1Co.1:30, Eph.1:7, 14 4:30, Col.1:14, Heb.9:15. (On the extent to WH. the word retains the sense of ransom, see ICC, Rom.3:24, Westc., He., 297 ff.; see also ICC, Eph., 11; DCG, ii, 605; Cremer, 410; Deiss., LAE, 331; Lft., Notes, 271, 316; Tr., Syn., § 77.)†
 (AS)
G0630G:
ἀπο-λύω 
 [in LXX for שׁוּב, etc., frequently in 1-4 Mac ;] 
__1. to set free, release: Luk.13:12, Jhn.19:10, al.; a debtor, Mat.18:27; metaphorically, of forgive­ness, Luk.6:37. 
 __2. to let go, dismiss (Field, Notes, 9 f.): Mat.15:23, Luk.2:29 9:12, Act.19:41, al.; of divorce, τ. γυναῖκα: Mat.1:19 5:31-32 19:3, 8 19:10 Mrk.10:2, 4 10:11, Luk.16:18; with ref. to Gk. and Rom. (net Jewish) custom, τ. ἄνδρα: Mrk.10:12. Mid., to depart: Act.28:25 (MM, see word) 
 (AS)
G0630H:
ἀπο-λύω 
 [in LXX for שׁוּב, etc., frequently in 1-4 Mac ;] 
__1. to set free, release: Luk.13:12, Jhn.19:10, al.; a debtor, Mat.18:27; metaphorically, of forgive­ness, Luk.6:37. 
 __2. to let go, dismiss (Field, Notes, 9 f.): Mat.15:23, Luk.2:29 9:12, Act.19:41, al.; of divorce, τ. γυναῖκα: Mat.1:19 5:31-32 19:3, 8 19:10 Mrk.10:2, 4 10:11, Luk.16:18; with ref. to Gk. and Rom. (net Jewish) custom, τ. ἄνδρα: Mrk.10:12. Mid., to depart: Act.28:25 (MM, see word) 
 (AS)
G0631:
απο-μάσσω
 (μάσσω, Att... -ττω, to touch, handle), [in LXX: Tob.7:17 * ;] 
to wipe off, wire clean: mid., Luk.10:11.†
 (AS)
G0632:
ἀπο-νέμω
 (νέμω, to distribute), [in LXX: Deu.4:19 (חָלַק), 3Ma.1:7 3Mac 3:16 * ;] 
to assign, apportion: 1Pe.3:7. (In π. of a Prefect who renders to all their dues; see MM, see word)†
 (AS)
G0633:
ἀπο-νίπτω 
 [in LXX for שָׁטַף, רָחַץ, מָחָה ;] 
to wash off: mid. (reflex.), τ. χεῖρας, Mat.27:24.†
 (AS)
G0634:
ἀπο-πίπτω 
 [in LXX for מָלַל, נָפַל, etc. ;] 
to fall off: Act.9:18.†
 (AS)
G0635:
ἀπο-πλανάω, -ῶ 
 [in LXX for נָדַח hi., נָטָה hi., שׁוּב pi. ;] 
to cause to go astray; metaphorically, of leading into error: Mrk.13:22; pass., to be led astray: 1Ti.6:10.†
 (AS)
G0637:
ἀπο-πλύνω 
 [in LXX chiefly for כָּבַס pi. ;] 
to wash off: seel. for πλύνω, Luk.5:2, Rec.†
 (AS)
G0638:
ἀπο-πνίγω 
 [in LXX: Nam.2:13 (חָנַק pi.), Tob.3:8 * ;] 
to choke: Mat.13:7, Luk.8:7; pass., of drowning (= καταποντίζομαι), Luk.8:33.†
 (AS)
G0639:
ἀπορέω, -ῶ
 (ἄπορος, ἀ- neg., πόρος, a way, resource), [in LXX for צָרַר, מוּךְ, etc. ;] 
to be at a loss, be perplexed: absol., Mrk.6:20 (ἐποίει, R, mg.); mid., be in doubt: absol., 2Co.4:8; with accusative, Act.25:20; before περί, Luk.24:4; ἐν, Gal.4:20; περὶ τίνος λέγει, Jhn.13:22.†
 SYN.: διαπορέω, διακρίνομαι, διστάζω, μετεωρίζομαι (see DCG, i, 491)  (AS)
G0640:
ἀπορία, -ας, ἡ
 (ἀπορέω), [in LXX for בֶּהָלָה, etc. ;] 
perplexity: Luk.21:25 (MM, see word; on the construction, see Field, Notes, 74 f.).†
 (AS)
G0641:
ἀπο-ρίπτω
 (Rec. -ρρίπτω, c1.), [in LXX for שָׁלַךְ hi., etc. ;] 
to throw away, cast forth: reflexively, Act.27:43 (BV, cast themselves overboard; see MM, see word).†
 (AS)
G0642:
ἀπ-ορφανίζω
 (ἀπό, ὀρφανός), 
to be bereaved (prop., of a parent, Lft., Notes, 36); metaphorically, 1Th.2:17 (where Field thinks it = χωρισθέντες, Notes, 199).†
 (AS)
G0643:
ἀπο-σκευάζω 
 [in LXX: Lev.14:36 (פָּנָה pi.) * ;] 
to pack and carry off; mid., to pack and remove one's goods: Act.21:15, Rec. (see ἐπισ-).†
 ἐπι-σκευάζω, 
 [in LXX for pm pi., etc. ;] 
to equip, make ready; mid., to make one's preparations: Act.21:15.†
 (AS)
G0644:
ἀπο-σκίασμα, -τος, τό
 (ἀποσκιάζω, to cast a shadow; v,s. σκία) 
a shadow: Jas.1:17 (MM, see word).†
 (AS)
G0645:
ἀπο-σπάω, -ῶ 
 [in LXX for נָתַק: ni., hi., etc. ;] 
to draw off or away, tear away (MM, see word): Act.20:30; μάχαιραν, draw a sword, Mat.26:51; pass., to be parted or withdrawn (Field, Notes, 134; but see Thayer, see word), Luk.22:41, Act.21:1.†
 (AS)
G0646:
άποστασία, -ας, ἡ
 (ἀφίστημι), [in LXX for מַעַל, etc. ;] 
defection, apostasy, revolt; in late Gk. (MM, Exp., viii; Lft., Notes, 111; Cremer, 308) for cl. ἀπόστασις, frequently in sense of political revolt, in LXX (e.g. Jos.22:22, 2Ch.29:19, Jer.2:19) and NT always of religious apostasy: Act.21:21, 2Th.2:3.†
 (AS)
G0647:
ἀποστάσιον, -ου, τό
 (ἀφίστημι), [in LXX; Deu.24:1, 3, Jer.3:8, Isa.50:1 (כְּרִיתוּת) * ;] 
__1. in cl., only in phrase ἀποστασίου δίκη, an action against a freedman for forsaking his προστάτης (Dem.). 
 __2. In LXX, βιβλίον ἀποστασίου, a bill of divorce: Mat.19:7, Mrk.10:4; in same sense ἀ. alone (MM, see word), Mat.5:31 (for other late exx., see MM, l.with; Kennedy, Sources, 121).†
 (AS)
G0648:
ἀπο-στεγάζω
 (στέγη), [in Sm.: Jer.29:11 * ;] 
to unroof: Mrk.2:4.†
 (AS)
G0650:
ἀπο-στερέω, -ῶ
 (στερέω, to rob), [in LXX: Exo.21:10 (גָּרַע), Deu.24:14 (עָשַׁק), Mal.3:5, Sir.4:1 29:6-7 31:21-22 * ;] 
to defraud, deprive of, despoil (in cl. chiefly of the misappropriation of trust funds, Field, Notes, 33; cf. MM, see word): absol., Mrk.10:19, 1Co.6:8; with accusative of person(s), 1Co.7:5. Mid., endure deprivation: 1Co.6:7 (WM, § 38, 3; but see Bl., § 54, 5; M, Pr., 162); pass., ἀπεστερημένοι, bereft of: 1Ti.6:5.†
 (AS)
G0651:
ἀπο-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
 (ἀποστέλλω), [in LXX: Deu.22:7, 3Ki.4:34 9:16 Psa.78:49, Ecc.8:8, Sng.4:13 (for שָׁלַח and its cognates), 1Es.9:51 Est.9:54, Jer.32:36, Bar.2:25, 1Ma.2:18, 2Ma.3:2 *.] 
__1. In cl., a sending away (MM, see word), as, an expedition (Hdt.). 
 __2. In LXX 
 __(a) discharge, dis­missal (Ecc.8:8); 
 __(b) a gift (3Ki.9:16, 1Ma.2:13). 
 __3. In NT, the office of an Apostle of Christ, apostleship: Act.1:25, Rom.1:5, 1Co.9:2, Gal.2:8 (Cremer, 530).†
 (AS)
G0652:
ἀπόστολος, -ου, ὁ
 (ἀοστέλλω), [in LXX; 3Ki.14:6 A (שָׁלַח) * ;] 
__1. a fleet, an expedition (Dem.). 
 __2. a messenger, one sent on a mission (Hdt., LXX, l.with, and π.; see M, Pr., 37 f.; MM, see word; M, Th., i, 2:7 and reff.): Jhn.13:16, 2Co.8:23 Php.2:25. 
 __3. In NT, an Apostle of Christ 
 __(a) with special ref. to the Twelve: Mat.10:2, Mrk.3:14, Luk.11:49, Eph.3:5, Rev.18:20, al., equality with whom is claimed by St. Paul, Gal.1:1, 11 ff, 1Ti.2:7, a1.; 
 __(b) in a wider sense of prominent Christian teachers, as Barnabas, Act.14:14, apparently also Silvanus and Timothy, 1Th.2:6, and perhaps Andronicus and Junias (Junia?), Rom.16:7 (see ICC, in l); of false teachers, claiming apostleship: 2Co.11:5 11:13, Rev.2:2. (On the different uses of the term in NT, see Lit., Gal., 92-101; Cremer, 530; DB, i, 126; DCG, i, 105; Enc. Br., ii, 196 ff.)
 (AS)
G0653:
ἀποστοματίζω
 (στόμα), 
__1. In cl., to speak from memory, to dic­tate to a pupil (Plat.). 
 __2. In late Gk., to catechize, question: Luk.11:53 (MM, see word).†
 (AS)
G0654:
ἀπο-στρέφω 
 [in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;] 
trans., with accusative, 
 __(a) to turn away, remove: Rom.11:26, 2Ti.4:4; metaphorically, to turn away from allegiance, pervert: Luk.23:14; 
 __(b) to turn back, return: μάχαιραν, Mat.26:52. Pass., reflex., to turn oneself away from: with accusative, Mat.5:42, 2Ti.1:15, Tit.1:14, Heb.12:25; so act., absol., Act.3:26 (cf. Sir.8:5; Bl., § 53, 1; Cremer, 880).†
 (AS)
G0655:
ἀπο-στυγέω, -ῶ
 (στυγέω, to hate), 
to abhor: Rom.12:9.†
 (AS)
G0656:
ἀποσυνάγωγος, -ον
 (συναγωγή), 
expelled from the congregation (Field, Notes, 96), excommunicated: Jhn.9:22 12:42 16:2 (Cremer, 64, 607).†
 (AS)
G0657:
ἀπο-τάσσω 
 [in LXX: Ecc.2:20 (יָאַשׁ pi.), I Est.6:27, Jer.20:2, 1-18; 1Ma.4:1-61 * ;] 
to set apart. Mid., in late Gk. (El., § 37, 1; Swete, Mk., 136 f.; MM, e. dative, 
 __(a) to take leave of: Mrk.6:46, Luk.9:61, Act.18:18, 21, 2Co.2:13; 
 __(b) to forsake: Luk.14:33.†
 (AS)
G0658:
ἀπο-τελέω, -ῶ 
 [in LXX: I Est.5:73, 1Ma.15:39 * ;] 
to bring to an end, complete, accomplish (cf. MM, see word): Luk.13:32, Jas.1:15.†
 (AS)
G0659:
ἀπο-τίθημι 
 [in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ hi. ;] 
to put off or aside; in NT always mid., 
 __(a) to put of from oneself as a garment: τ. ἱμάτια, Act.7:58; metaphorically, in ethical sense, to put of, lay aside: Rom.13:12, Eph.4:22, 25, Col.3:8, Heb.12:1, Jas.1:21, 1Pe.2:1; 
 __(b) to stow away, put: ἐν τ. φυλακῇ (MM, see word), Mat.14:3.†
 (AS)
G0660:
ἀπο-τινάσσω 
 [in LXX: Jdg.16:20 A (נָעַר ni.), 1Ki.10:2 (נָטַשׁ), La 2:7 (נָאַר pi.) * ;] 
to shake of: Luk.9:5, Act.28:5.†
